title: Announcement on the Extension of the Zero Trading Service Fee and Zero On-Chain Gas Fee Promotion for ONDO Tokenized Securities
text: This is a general announcement. This announcement is not intended for users in jurisdictions where access to or trading in tokenized securities is restricted or prohibited. Participation is subject to eligibility requirements, jurisdictional restrictions, applicable terms, and any checks or controls imposed by Binance Wallet and/or the relevant third-party provider. Fellow Binancians, Binance Wallet is updating the Promotion Period for eligible transactions involving supported ONDO tokenized securities within Binance Wallet’s Keyless Wallet. The promotion was originally scheduled to end at  2026-06-18 12:00 (UTC) , and has now been extended to  2026-07-18 12:00 (UTC) . During the Promotion Period, eligible users who trade supported ONDO tokenized securities through Binance Wallet’s Keyless Wallet may continue to enjoy: Zero service fees:  During the Promotion Period, all ONDO tokenized U.S. stock securities traded within Binance Wallet (Keyless) will be exempt from service fees.  Zero on-chain gas fees:  Users will not be required to bear the network gas fees incurred from eligible on-chain transactions. In addition, effective from the extension of this promotion, trading ONDO tokenized securities via Binance Wallet (Web) can also enjoy  zero service fees and zero on-chain gas fees , while trading ONDO tokenized securities via the Binance Wallet Extension can enjoy  zero service fees . Except for the extended Promotion Period and the newly added support for the Web platform and Extension as described above, all promotion rules, participation requirements, supported assets, and other related terms and conditions remain unchanged. For more details about the promotion, please refer to the original  announcement . Any subsequent changes will be separately announced. Note: There may be discrepancies between this original content in English and any translated versions. Please refer to the original English version for the most accurate information, in case any discrepancies arise. Thank you for your support!
